title: ناخن شماره ۸: انتقام استون
format: Sequel to scenario 02 (same movie-trailer parody: letterbox bars, film grain, dramatic title cards). HIGHER motion than 02: tracking shots, whip-pans, dolly zoom, orbit, barrel roll, speed lines, parallax, screen shake on hits, cuts on the beat. Cute, never scary.
goal: Share-worthy sequel reel. 32-40 s. Hook in 1 s, one wow-motion beat every 2-3 s, a twist ending that teases the next episode, loop-friendly.

cast.name: Number 7
cast.desc: tiny pink almond-nail blob with a small bandage, braver now

cast.name: Gel
cast.desc: glossy translucent-blue knight blob with a gel-drop helmet and a brush sword

cast.name: Number 8
cast.desc: glossy ruby-red almond-nail blob, tiny sunglasses, big attitude, skates on a nail file

cast.name: Acetone
cast.desc: cute-menacing glass bottle with a glowing green eye, cap like a crown, green vapor tentacles

cast.name: Cotton army
cast.desc: fluffy white cotton-ball blobs with tiny angry eyes, march in formation

cast.name: Number 9
cast.desc: giant sleepy toenail blob in a tiny sock hat, rises like a kaiju

scenes.text: ناخن شماره هفت زنده موند... ولی دشمن برگشته
scenes.idea: MOTION HIGH. Open on a quick slow-mo recap flash of Number 7's victory pose, then a toxic-green shadow sweeps across the frame and shatters it like glass; giant title card slams in 'قسمت ۲' with screen shake and green fume particles. Whip-pan to black.

scenes.text: از اعماق یه شیشه‌ی کوچیک... استون بیدار شد
scenes.idea: Dolly-in on a dark vanity shelf: a glass acetone bottle slowly opens one glowing green eye; the cap lifts like a crown, vapor tentacles uncoil and fill the frame, smell-waves ripple the whole image with a heat-haze distortion. Cute-menacing, never gory.

Top-down then low-angle: an army of fluffy cotton-ball minions with tiny angry eyes marches in perfect rows, then multiplies and swarms across a pastel table like a wave; camera crane sweeps over them, parallax of marching legs, dust puffs on every beat.

scenes.text: و ناخن شماره هشت وارد شد!
scenes.idea: Smash cut to bright color: Number 8, a glossy ruby-red rookie blob with tiny sunglasses and attitude, drops from above onto a nail file used as a skateboard; sparks fly from the grit, a power slide stops dead at camera with a 'wanted' freeze-frame and cool title card.

MOTION MAX. High-speed parkour chase across a giant hand landscape: knuckle bridges, rings as hoops, bracelet as a zip-line, cuticle-cliff jumps; tracking shot with speed lines and motion blur, camera barrel-rolls on jumps, cotton minions bounce off walls in pursuit.

Acetone's vapor wave catches Number 8; its red color starts melting and dripping, face goes pale; dramatic dolly-zoom as the green cloud closes in, Number 8 clings to the edge of a nail with trembling hands; heartbeat pulse in the picture.

scenes.text: تا اینکه شماره هفت و ژل رسیدن
scenes.idea: Backlit slow-motion silhouette in the green fog: Number 7 and Gel stride in side by side, cape of sparkles fluttering, fog parts like curtains; 360-degree orbit around the trio, then a snap-zoom to Number 8's relieved face.

scenes.text: یه تاپ‌کت... و همه‌چی تموم شد!
scenes.idea: Fast action beat on the audio hits: Gel slashes a top-coat shield across the screen, vapor bounces off in a rainbow-gloss reflection, the beam reflects back and pushes Acetone into his bottle, cap closes with a big clink, ground-shake; Acetone starts snoring bubbles. Freeze-frame high-five.

scenes.text: ولی صبر کن... یکی داره از پا میاد
scenes.idea: Quiet beat then twist: everything calm, then the whole frame rumbles; from the bottom edge a gigantic sleepy toenail blob, Number 9, in a tiny sock-hat slowly rises like a kaiju, sleepy eyes opening, lens flare behind it. Camera tilts up in awe, title sting 'ناخن شماره نُه'.

scenes.text: تگ کن اونی رو که از استون می‌ترسه
scenes.idea: Everyone (7, 8, Gel, sleepy 9) lines up and points at the viewer together; sparkling nail-lamp spotlight; quick match-cut loop back to the opening title; end-card @ayda.nailroom.
